violation_type.title: Hand Sanitizer - Use by Children Supervised by Adult (26 TAC §746.3420(4))
violation_type.short_title: Hand Sanitizer - Use by Children Supervised by Adult
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during DFPS investigation it was determined that children utilized hand sanitizer without adult supervision and the hand sanitizer remained on a table and accessible to children.
